subject.title: fix(codex): require explicit final source delivery

question: Should Codex `message_tool_only` completion become an explicit model-facing `final=true` contract, or should OpenClaw preserve delivery-confirmed termination and rely on final-only prompt guidance?
rationale: Both approaches address the bug but establish different long-term compatibility, timeout, and model-compliance failure modes that code review cannot choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt explicit final
options.body: Approve this Codex-scoped runtime contract after exact-head proof, then make it the canonical fix and retain only concise complementary prompt guidance.

options.title: Keep implicit completion
options.body: Preserve receipt-based terminality and proceed with the proof-positive prompt-only candidate at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100156 instead.

recommendation.title: Adopt explicit final
recommendation.body: Approve this Codex-scoped runtime contract after exact-head proof, then make it the canonical fix and retain only concise complementary prompt guidance.
